title: Billing and Coding: BRCA1 and BRCA2 Genetic Testing

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes: 81162, 81163, 81164, 81165, 81166, 81167, 81212, 81215, 81216, 81217, 81432, and 81479.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
